1.Nf3 c5 2.c4 Nc6 3.g3 g6 4.Bg2 Bg7 5.O-.strategy: Brings the second knight into play and adds to the control of d5 and e4. White has castled and Black has not yet, in a mirror set-up; the c4 pawn gives White a little more space, and the game is balanced until one side finds a plan in the centre.
1.Nf3 c5 2.c4 Nc6 3.g3 g6 4.Bg2 Bg7 5.O-.name: English Opening: Symmetrical Variation, Three Knights, Fianchetto Variation
